import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const categorySchema = z.enum(['billing', 'refund', 'technical', 'account', 'other']);
const category = H.facet('category', categorySchema.options);

const conversationSchema = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  customerEmail: z.string(),
  slaDeadline: z.string(),
});
type ConversationAttributes = z.infer<typeof conversationSchema>;

const New = H.state('New', 'pending');
const Sent = H.terminal('Sent', 'success');
const ClosedByCustomer = H.terminal('ClosedByCustomer', 'neutral');
const Escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'failure');

const Conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationSchema)
  .states(New, Sent, ClosedByCustomer, Escalated)
  .key(a => a.ticketId)
  .initial(New);

const EscalationOpen = H.state('EscalationOpen', 'pending');
const EscalationHandled = H.terminal('EscalationHandled', 'success');
const EscalationDropped = H.terminal('EscalationDropped', 'neutral');

const Escalation = H.kind('Escalation')
  .attributes(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), subject: z.string(), reason: z.string() }))
  .states(EscalationOpen, EscalationHandled, EscalationDropped)
  .key(a => a.ticketId)
  .initial(EscalationOpen);

const customerReplied = H.signal('customer-replied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customer-closed');
const slaBreached = H.signal('sla-breached');

const quota = sqlite.quota('support-quota', { path: './.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const api = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const pool = H.pool('support').accounts(api);

const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const classifier = H.role('classifier').intents('read').instructions('Assign exactly one category to the conversation.');
const drafter = H.role('drafter').intents('read').instructions('Draft the next reply to the customer.');
const reviewer = H.role('reviewer').intents('record').instructions('Approve or edit outgoing replies.');

const classifierSeat = H.seat('classifier').role(classifier).model(haiku).pool(pool);
const drafterSeat = H.seat('drafter').role(drafter).model(sonnet).pool(pool);

const classifyCall = H.call('classify', classifierSeat).output(z.object({ category: categorySchema }));
const draftCall = H.call('draft', drafterSeat).output(z.object({ reply: z.string() }));

const approval = H.halt('reply-approval').decision(
  z.object({ approve: z.boolean(), editedReply: z.string().optional(), notes: z.string().optional() }),
);
const costCeiling = H.halt('conversation-cost-ceiling').decision(H.ceilingDecision);
const escalationHandling = H.halt('escalation-handling').decision(z.object({ resolution: z.string() }));

const safeCategory = H.policy.halt('safe-category', Conversation, approval).decide(ctx => {
  const approvals = ctx.metrics.rate(approvalRate, { facets: ctx.facets });
  return approvals.hits >= 200 && approvals.hits === approvals.samples ? { approve: true } : undefined;
});

const helpdeskToken = H.env('ZENDESK_TOKEN');
const sendReply = H.command('send-reply')
  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), reply: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['helpdesk-reply', '--ticket', i.ticketId, '--body', i.reply]);

const conversationFlow = H.flow('conversation')
  .input(conversationSchema)
  .step('classify', classifyCall, ctx => ({
    text: `Classify this conversation.\nSubject: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}`,
  }))
  .loop(
    'drafts',
    { schema: z.array(z.string()), initial: [] },
    round =>
      round
        .step('draft', draftCall, ctx => ({
          text: `Reply to the customer about "${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}" (${ctx.steps.classify.category}).\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.message}\n\nReviewer notes so far: ${ctx.steps.drafts.join('; ')}`,
        }))
        .halt('approval', approval, {
          ask: ctx => `Approve this reply to ticket ${ctx.unit.key}:\n\n${ctx.steps.draft.reply}`,
          skip: safeCategory,
          facets: ctx => [category.of(ctx.steps.classify.category)],
        }),
    {
      max: 3,
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.approval.approve,
      next: ctx => [...ctx.steps.drafts, ctx.steps.approval.notes ?? 'rejected without notes'],
    },
  )
  .exit('notApproved', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approve)
  .step(
    'send',
    sendReply,
    ctx => ({ ticketId: ctx.unit.attributes.ticketId, reply: ctx.steps.approval.editedReply ?? ctx.steps.draft.reply }),
    { afterCrash: 'park' },
  )
  .exit('sent');

const slaHours: Record<ZendeskEvent['priority'], number> = { urgent: 1, high: 4, normal: 24, low: 72 };

function routeTicket(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttributes>): Route {
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      message: event.message,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      slaDeadline: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3_600_000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  if (event.status === 'closed' || event.status === 'solved') return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  if (event.type === 'replied') return to.signal(customerReplied, event.ticketId, { message: event.message });
  return to.skip();
}

const conversations = H.lane('conversations', Conversation)
  .supply(zendesk.webhook({ port: H.slot.port(0), path: '/zendesk', secret: H.env('ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET') }), routeTicket)
  .supply(zendesk.poll({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken, everyMinutes: 10 }), routeTicket)
  .handler(conversationFlow, { exits: { notApproved: Escalated, sent: Sent } })
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 30_000, exhausted: Escalated })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 0.4, onExceed: costCeiling })
  .on(customerReplied, {
    update: (attributes, payload) => ({ ...attributes, message: payload.message }),
    restart: 'classify',
    at: ['approval'],
  })
  .on(customerClosed, { enter: ClosedByCustomer })
  .on(slaBreached, { enter: Escalated });

const escalationFlow = H.flow('escalation')
  .halt('handle', escalationHandling, {
    ask: ctx => `Ticket ${ctx.unit.key} breached its SLA. Handle it with the customer and record the resolution.`,
  })
  .exit('handled');

const escalations = H.lane('escalations', Escalation)
  .handler(escalationFlow, { exits: { handled: EscalationHandled } })
  .store(zendesk.store({ subdomain: 'acme', token: helpdeskToken }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: EscalationDropped });

const approvalRate = H.metric('approval-rate', H.when.decision(Conversation, approval)).samples(e =>
  e.resolvedBy === 'human'
    ? [{ hit: e.decision.approve, facets: e.facets, seat: drafterSeat, model: e.modelOf(drafterSeat) }]
    : [],
);

const slaBreach = H.trigger('sla-breach-escalates')
  .on(
    H.when.timer(conversations, {
      at: unit => (unit.position === 'terminal' ? undefined : new Date(unit.attributes.slaDeadline)),
    }),
  )
  .create(escalations, e => ({
    ticketId: e.unit.attributes.ticketId,
    subject: e.unit.attributes.subject,
    reason: `SLA deadline ${e.unit.attributes.slaDeadline} passed`,
  }))
  .signal(slaBreached, conversations, e => ({ key: e.unit.key, payload: {} }));

const tasteKind = H.memory('support-taste', 'taste');
const experienceKind = H.memory('support-experience', 'experience');

const taste = H.journal('support-taste', tasteKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './memory/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(drafter)
  .recordedBy(reviewer);

const experience = H.journal('support-experience', experienceKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './memory/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(drafter);

const reviewerEdits = H.trigger('reviewer-notes-become-taste')
  .on(H.when.decision(Conversation, approval))
  .record(taste, e =>
    e.resolvedBy === 'human' && e.decision.notes !== undefined
      ? { text: e.decision.notes, status: 'candidate', when: { kinds: [Conversation], roles: [drafter] } }
      : undefined,
  );

const scheduler = H.scheduler('support')
  .fixedDate(conversations, unit => new Date(unit.attributes.slaDeadline))
  .standard(escalations);

const reviewerConsole = claudeCode.supervisor('reviewer-console', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workUpdate,
    H.ops.resolve(approval, costCeiling, escalationHandling),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

const support = H.harness('support-triage')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(conversations, escalations)
  .journals(taste, experience)
  .triggers(slaBreach, reviewerEdits)
  .metrics(approvalRate)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(reviewerConsole)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './TELEMETRY.md' }));

void support.start();

const topicSchema = z.object({
  slug: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  question: z.string(),
  tags: z.array(z.string()),
});

const Open = H.state('Open', 'pending');
const Delivered = H.terminal('Delivered', 'success');
const Parked = H.terminal('Parked', 'neutral');
const Withdrawn = H.terminal('Withdrawn', 'neutral');
const Failed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');

const Topic = H.kind('Topic')
  .attributes(topicSchema)
  .states(Open, Delivered, Parked, Withdrawn, Failed)
  .key(a => a.slug)
  .initial(Open);

const quota = sqlite.quota('research-quota', { path: './.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const api = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const pool = H.pool('research').accounts(api);

const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const extractor = H.role('extractor').intents('search', 'browse').instructions('Search for the query and extract sourced claims.');
const synthesizer = H.role('synthesizer').intents('read', 'record').instructions('Write a sourced report; every claim carries a citation.');

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizer-model', [opus, sonnet], ctx => {
  const opusPass = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { seat: ctx.seat, model: opus, window: { lastDays: 30 } });
  const sonnetPass = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { seat: ctx.seat, model: sonnet, window: { lastDays: 30 } });
  if (opusPass.samples < 20) return opus;
  if (sonnetPass.samples < 20) return sonnet;
  return opusPass.rate >= sonnetPass.rate ? opus : sonnet;
});

const extractorSeat = H.seat('extractor').role(extractor).model(haiku).pool(pool);
const synthesizerSeat = H.seat('synthesizer').role(synthesizer).model(synthesizerModel).pool(pool);

const extractCall = H.call('search-and-extract', extractorSeat).output(
  z.object({ sources: z.array(z.object({ url: z.string(), claim: z.string() })) }),
);
const synthesizeCall = H.call('synthesize', synthesizerSeat).output(
  z.object({ report: z.string(), citations: z.array(z.string()), keyFinding: z.string() }),
);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const planQueries = H.command('plan-queries')
  .input(z.object({ question: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['research-plan', '--count', '20', i.question])
  .output(z.object({ queries: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .runner(localRunner);
const checkCitations = H.command('check-citations')
  .input(z.object({ citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(i => ['check-citations', ...i.citations])
  .runner(localRunner);

const researchFlow = H.flow('research')
  .input(topicSchema)
  .step('plan', planQueries, ctx => ({ question: ctx.unit.attributes.question }))
  .job('extract', H.batch(extractCall), ctx =>
    ctx.steps.plan.queries.map(query => ({ text: `Search for "${query}" and extract claims with their source URLs.` })),
  )
  .exit('notEnoughSources', ctx => ctx.steps.extract.reduce((count, r) => count + r.sources.length, 0) < 5)
  .step('synthesize', synthesizeCall, ctx => ({
    text: `Answer: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}\n\nSources:\n${JSON.stringify(ctx.steps.extract.flatMap(r => r.sources))}`,
  }))
  .step('cite', checkCitations, ctx => ({ citations: ctx.steps.synthesize.citations }))
  .exit('delivered');

const recurringClock = H.clock('weekly-recurring').at('06:00', { on: 'mon', tz: 'UTC' });

const topics = H.lane('topics', Topic)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(sqlite.scan('recurring-topics', { path: './.harness/store.sqlite', kind: 'Topic', schedule: recurringClock }), (stored, to) => {
    const parsed = topicSchema.safeParse(stored.attributes);
    return parsed.success && parsed.data.tags.includes('recurring') ? to.create(parsed.data) : to.skip();
  })
  .handler(researchFlow, { exits: { notEnoughSources: Parked, delivered: Delivered } })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: './.harness/store.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 120_000, exhausted: Failed })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 3, onExceed: 'fail' })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: Withdrawn });

const citationPass = H.metric('citation-pass', H.when.step(topics, 'cite')).samples(e => [
  { hit: e.ok, seat: synthesizerSeat, model: e.modelOf(synthesizerSeat) },
]);
const succeededTopicCost = H.metric('succeeded-topic-cost', H.when.transition(topics, { to: Delivered })).amounts(e =>
  e.attempt ? [{ amount: e.attempt.costUsd }] : [],
);

const findingsKind = H.memory('report-findings', 'experience');

  .clients(operatorConsole)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { H, Runner } from 'harness-dsl';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';

import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';

import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const serviceSchema = z.enum(['api', 'web', 'worker']);
const databaseSchema = z.enum(['orders', 'users']);
const domainSchema = z.enum(['example.com', 'api.example.com']);
const incidentSchema = z.object({
  ref: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  source: z.enum(['heartbeat', 'backup', 'operator']),
});

const HeartbeatDue = H.state('HeartbeatDue', 'pending');
const Healthy = H.terminal('Healthy', 'success');
const Unhealthy = H.terminal('Unhealthy', 'failure');
const Heartbeat = H.kind('Heartbeat')
  .attributes(z.object({ service: serviceSchema }))
  .states(HeartbeatDue, Healthy, Unhealthy)
  .key(a => a.service)
  .initial(HeartbeatDue);

const BackupDue = H.state('BackupDue', 'pending');
const BackedUp = H.terminal('BackedUp', 'success');
const BackupFailed = H.terminal('BackupFailed', 'failure');
const Backup = H.kind('Backup')
  .attributes(z.object({ database: databaseSchema }))
  .states(BackupDue, BackedUp, BackupFailed)
  .key(a => a.database)
  .initial(BackupDue);

const RenewalDue = H.state('RenewalDue', 'pending');
const CertificateValid = H.terminal('CertificateValid', 'success');
const CertificateRenewed = H.terminal('CertificateRenewed', 'success');
const RenewalFailed = H.terminal('RenewalFailed', 'failure');
const CertificateRenewal = H.kind('CertificateRenewal')
  .attributes(z.object({ domain: domainSchema }))
  .states(RenewalDue, CertificateValid, CertificateRenewed, RenewalFailed)
  .key(a => a.domain)
  .initial(RenewalDue);

const IncidentOpen = H.state('IncidentOpen', 'pending');
const IncidentResolved = H.terminal('IncidentResolved', 'success');
const IncidentUnresolved = H.terminal('IncidentUnresolved', 'failure');
const Incident = H.kind('Incident')
  .attributes(incidentSchema)
  .states(IncidentOpen, IncidentResolved, IncidentUnresolved)
  .key(a => a.ref)
  .initial(IncidentOpen);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const diskCheck = H.command('disk-space-preflight').argv(['sh', '-c', 'test "$(df --output=avail -k / | tail -1)" -gt 10485760']);
const sshKey = H.env('OPS_SSH_KEY');
const opsA = ssh.host('ops-a', { host: 'ops-a.internal', user: 'ops', key: sshKey }).slots(1).preflight(diskCheck);
const opsB = ssh.host('ops-b', { host: 'ops-b.internal', user: 'ops', key: sshKey }).slots(1).preflight(diskCheck);

const backupHost: Record<z.infer<typeof databaseSchema>, Runner> = { orders: opsA, users: opsB };
const renewalHost: Record<z.infer<typeof domainSchema>, Runner> = { 'example.com': opsA, 'api.example.com': opsB };
const databaseResource = { orders: H.resource('orders-db'), users: H.resource('users-db') };

const probe = H.command('heartbeat-probe')
  .input(z.object({ service: serviceSchema }))
  .argv(i => ['./probe.sh', i.service])
  .runner(localRunner);
const runBackup = H.command('backup')
  .input(z.object({ database: databaseSchema }))
  .argv(i => ['./backup.sh', i.database])
  .runner(i => backupHost[i.database]);
const checkExpiry = H.command('certificate-days-left')
  .input(z.object({ domain: domainSchema }))
  .argv(i => ['./cert-days-left.sh', i.domain])
  .output(z.object({ daysLeft: z.number() }))
  .runner(i => renewalHost[i.domain]);
const renewCertificate = H.command('renew-certificate')
  .input(z.object({ domain: domainSchema }))
  .argv(i => ['./renew-cert.sh', i.domain])
  .runner(i => renewalHost[i.domain]);
const pageOnCall = H.command('page-on-call')
  .input(z.object({ title: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./page.sh', i.title])
  .runner(localRunner);
const runbook = H.command('incident-runbook')
  .input(z.object({ ref: z.string(), source: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./runbook.sh', i.source, i.ref])
  .runner(localRunner);

const acknowledgement = H.halt('incident-acknowledgement').decision(z.object({ note: z.string().optional() }));
const resolutionCheck = H.halt('incident-resolution').decision(z.object({ resolved: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }));

const heartbeatFlow = H.flow('heartbeat')
  .input(z.object({ service: serviceSchema }))
  .step('probe', probe, ctx => ({ service: ctx.unit.attributes.service }))
  .exit('healthy');

const backupFlow = H.flow('backup')
  .input(z.object({ database: databaseSchema }))
  .step('backup', runBackup, ctx => ({ database: ctx.unit.attributes.database }))
  .exit('backedUp');

const renewalFlow = H.flow('certificate-renewal')
  .input(z.object({ domain: domainSchema }))
  .step('check', checkExpiry, ctx => ({ domain: ctx.unit.attributes.domain }))
  .exit('stillValid', ctx => ctx.steps.check.daysLeft >= 14)
  .step('renew', renewCertificate, ctx => ({ domain: ctx.unit.attributes.domain }))
  .exit('renewed');

const incidentFlow = H.flow('incident-runbook')
  .input(incidentSchema)
  .step('page', pageOnCall, ctx => ({ title: ctx.unit.attributes.title }))
  .halt('acknowledge', acknowledgement, { ask: ctx => `Acknowledge incident ${ctx.unit.key}: ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}` })
  .loop(
    'remediation',
    round =>
      round
        .step('runbook', runbook, ctx => ({ ref: ctx.unit.attributes.ref, source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }))
        .halt('confirm', resolutionCheck, { ask: ctx => `The runbook ran for ${ctx.unit.key}. Is the incident resolved?` }),
    { max: 3, until: ctx => ctx.steps.confirm.resolved },
  )
  .exit('resolved', ctx => ctx.steps.confirm.resolved)
  .exit('unresolved');

const heartbeats = H.lane('heartbeats', Heartbeat)
  .supply(H.clock('every-five-minutes').every({ minutes: 5 }), (tick, to) =>
    serviceSchema.options.map(service => to.create({ service })),
  )
  .handler(heartbeatFlow, { exits: { healthy: Healthy } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: Unhealthy });

const backups = H.lane('backups', Backup)
  .supply(H.clock('nightly-backup').at('01:00', { tz: 'UTC' }), (tick, to) =>
    databaseSchema.options.map(database => to.create({ database })),
  )
  .handler(backupFlow, { exits: { backedUp: BackedUp } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: BackupFailed });

const renewals = H.lane('certificate-renewals', CertificateRenewal)
  .supply(H.clock('weekly-certificates').at('03:00', { on: 'mon', tz: 'UTC' }), (tick, to) =>
    domainSchema.options.map(domain => to.create({ domain })),
  )
  .handler(renewalFlow, { exits: { stillValid: CertificateValid, renewed: CertificateRenewed } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: RenewalFailed });

const incidents = H.lane('incidents', Incident)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(incidentFlow, { exits: { resolved: IncidentResolved, unresolved: IncidentUnresolved } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 60_000, exhausted: IncidentUnresolved });

const opsExperienceKind = H.memory('operational-experience', 'experience');
const opsNotes = H.journal('operational-experience', opsExperienceKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './memory/ops.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 20 });

const twoHoursMs = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const heartbeatStreak = H.trigger('three-failed-heartbeats-open-incident')
  .on(H.when.pattern(heartbeats, { to: Unhealthy, consecutive: 3, per: unit => unit.attributes.service }))
  .create(incidents, e => ({
    ref: `heartbeat-${e.group}`,
    title: `${e.group} failed ${e.streak} consecutive heartbeats`,
    source: 'heartbeat',
  }));

const backupFailure = H.trigger('failed-backup-opens-incident')
  .on(H.when.transition(backups, { to: BackupFailed }))
  .create(incidents, e => ({
    ref: `backup-${e.unit.attributes.database}-${e.at.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
    title: `Backup of ${e.unit.attributes.database} failed`,
    source: 'backup',
  }));

const slowBackup = H.trigger('slow-backup-records-note')
  .on(H.when.transition(backups, { to: BackedUp, if: e => (e.attempt ? e.attempt.durationMs : 0) > twoHoursMs }))
  .record(opsNotes, e => ({
    text: `When scheduling the ${e.unit.attributes.database} backup, allow more than two hours, because the run finishing ${e.at.toISOString()} took ${Math.round((e.attempt ? e.attempt.durationMs : 0) / 60_000)} minutes.`,
    status: 'active',
    when: { kinds: [Backup], resources: [databaseResource[e.unit.attributes.database]] },
  }));

const scheduler = H.scheduler('operations')
  .expedite(incidents, { holds: [backups] })
  .standard(heartbeats, renewals, backups);

const controlApi = http.controlApi('ops-control-api', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  token: H.env('OPS_API_TOKEN'),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.resolve(acknowledgement, resolutionCheck),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

const operations = H.harness('operations')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(heartbeats, backups, renewals, incidents)
  .journals(opsNotes)
  .triggers(heartbeatStreak, backupFailure, slowBackup)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(controlApi)
  .observers(
    slack.notifier('incident-alerts', { webhookUrl: H.env('SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL'), lanes: [incidents] }),
    markdown.board({ path: './BOARD.md' }),
  );

void operations.start();

  .attributes(loadSchema)

const localRunner = local.runner('local');

const extract = H.command('extract')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(i => ['etl', 'extract', i.source])
  .runner(etlHost);

  .argv(i => ['etl', 'validate', i.source])

  .runner(localRunner);

  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(i => ['etl', 'load', i.source])
  .runner(etlHost);
const verify = H.command('verify')
  .input(sourceInput)
  .argv(i => ['etl', 'verify', i.source])
  .output(z.object({ drift: z.enum(['none', 'tolerable', 'excessive']) }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const quota = sqlite.quota('data-quota', { path: './.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const api = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });

const summarizerSeat = H.seat('anomaly-summarizer').role(summarizer).model(sonnet).pool(pool);
const summarizeCall = H.call('summarize-anomalies', summarizerSeat).output(z.object({ summary: z.string() }));

const loadApproval = H.halt('load-approval').decision(z.object({ approve: z.boolean(), note: z.string().optional() }));

const nightlyFlow = H.flow('nightly-load')
  .input(loadSchema)
  .step('extract', extract, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { retry: stepRetry, afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('validate', validate, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }))
  .halt('validationReview', validationReview, {
    when: ctx => !ctx.steps.validate.ok,
    ask: ctx => `Validation failed for ${ctx.unit.key}. Proceed anyway?\n\n${ctx.steps.validate.report}`,
  })
  .exit('rejectedAtValidation', ctx => ctx.steps.validationReview?.proceed === false)
  .step('summarize', summarizeCall, ctx => ({

  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approve)
  .step('load', load, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }), { retry: stepRetry, afterCrash: 'park' })
  .step('verify', verify, ctx => ({ source: ctx.unit.attributes.source }))

  .store(sqlite.store({ path: './.harness/store.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: LoadFailed })

const approvalDeadline = H.trigger('approval-closes-at-0900')

});

const dataJob = H.harness('nightly-data')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(loads)
  .journals(approverTaste)
  .triggers(approvalDeadline)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('nightly').standard(loads))
  .clients(approverConsole)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { H, Model, ModelPolicy, Resource } from 'harness-dsl';

import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const sectionSchema = z.enum(['sports', 'opinion', 'general']);
type Section = z.infer<typeof sectionSchema>;
const draftSchema = z.object({ entryId: z.string(), title: z.string(), section: sectionSchema, body: z.string() });

const sectionResources = { sports: H.resource('sports'), opinion: H.resource('opinion') };
function sectionScope(section: Section): readonly Resource[] {
  return section === 'general' ? [] : [sectionResources[section]];
}

const InReview = H.state('InReview', 'pending');
const Accepted = H.terminal('Accepted', 'success');
const Returned = H.terminal('Returned', 'neutral');
const ReviewFailed = H.terminal('ReviewFailed', 'failure');

const Draft = H.kind('Draft')
  .attributes(draftSchema)
  .states(InReview, Accepted, Returned, ReviewFailed)
  .key(a => a.entryId)
  .initial(InReview);

const quota = sqlite.quota('content-quota', { path: './.harness/quota.sqlite' });
const api = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const pool = H.pool('content').accounts(api);

const opusNew = anthropic.model('opus-4-1', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const opusOld = anthropic.model('opus-4', { id: 'claude-opus-4' });
const sonnetNew = anthropic.model('sonnet-4-5', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const sonnetOld = anthropic.model('sonnet-4', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4' });

function swapWeaker(name: string, candidates: readonly [Model, Model]): ModelPolicy {
  const [first, second] = candidates;
  return H.policy.model(name, candidates, ctx => {
    const current = ctx.current ?? first;
    const peer = ctx.peers[0];
    if (!peer) return current;
    const mine = ctx.metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { seat: ctx.seat, model: current, window: { lastDays: 60 } });
    const theirs = ctx.metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { seat: peer, window: { lastDays: 60 } });
    if (mine.samples < 50 || theirs.samples < 50) return current;
    return mine.rate < theirs.rate ? (current === first ? second : first) : current;
  });
}

const reviewer = H.role('reviewer').intents('read').instructions('Critique the draft for argument, accuracy and house style.');
const reviewerA = H.seat('reviewer-a').role(reviewer).model(swapWeaker('reviewer-a-model', [opusNew, opusOld])).pool(pool);
const reviewerB = H.seat('reviewer-b').role(reviewer).model(swapWeaker('reviewer-b-model', [sonnetNew, sonnetOld])).pool(pool);

const critique = z.object({ critique: z.string() });
const reviewCallA = H.call('critique-a', reviewerA).output(critique);
const reviewCallB = H.call('critique-b', reviewerB).output(critique);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ entryId: z.string(), body: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['fact-check', '--entry', i.entryId, '--body', i.body])
  .output(z.object({ lesson: z.string().optional() }))
  .runner(localRunner);
const mergeCritiques = H.command('merge-critiques')
  .input(z.object({ a: z.string(), b: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['merge-critiques', '--a', i.a, '--b', i.b])
  .output(z.object({ merged: z.string() }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const editorVerdict = H.halt('editor-verdict').decision(
  z.object({
    action: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
    notes: z.string(),
    actedOn: z.enum(['a', 'b', 'both', 'neither']),
  }),
);

const reviewFlow = H.flow('draft-review')
  .input(draftSchema)
  .step('factCheck', factCheck, ctx => ({ entryId: ctx.unit.attributes.entryId, body: ctx.unit.attributes.body }))
  .step('critiqueA', reviewCallA, ctx => ({
    text: `Critique "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}":\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.body}`,
    resources: sectionScope(ctx.unit.attributes.section),
  }))
  .step('critiqueB', reviewCallB, ctx => ({
    text: `Critique "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}":\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.body}`,
    resources: sectionScope(ctx.unit.attributes.section),
  }))
  .step('merge', mergeCritiques, ctx => ({ a: ctx.steps.critiqueA.critique, b: ctx.steps.critiqueB.critique }))
  .halt('editor', editorVerdict, {
    ask: ctx => `Accept or return "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}"?\n\n${ctx.steps.merge.merged}`,
  })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.editor.action === 'accept')
  .exit('returned');

const contentToken = H.env('CONTENTFUL_TOKEN');
const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .supply(contentful.drafts({ space: 'newsroom', token: contentToken, everyMinutes: 10 }), (entry, to) =>
    to.create({
      entryId: entry.id,
      title: entry.title,
      section: sectionSchema.catch('general').parse(entry.section),

  .argv(input => ['./contracts/execute', input.contractId])
  .runner(runner);

const contractFlow = H.flow('contract')
  .input(ContractAttrs)
  .loop(
    'reviews',
    { schema: z.array(z.string()), initial: [] },
    round =>
      round
        .step('draft', draftCall, ctx => ({
          text: [
            `Draft ${ctx.unit.attributes.title} (${ctx.unit.attributes.category}).`,
            `Redlines:\n${ctx.unit.attributes.redlines.join('\n')}`,
            `Counsel notes:\n${ctx.steps.reviews.join('\n')}`,
          ].join('\n\n'),
          facets: [category.of(ctx.unit.attributes.category)],
        }))
        .halt('counsel', counsel, {
          ask: ctx => `Review ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}:\n\n${ctx.steps.draft}`,
          skip: skipCounselWhenProven,
          facets: ctx => [category.of(ctx.unit.attributes.category)],
        }),
    {
      max: 2,
      span: 'unit',
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.counsel.verdict === 'approve',
      next: ctx => [...ctx.steps.reviews, ctx.steps.counsel.notes],
    },
  )
  .exit('declined', ctx => ctx.steps.counsel.verdict === 'return')
  .halt('signoff', signoff, {
    ask: ctx => `Sign off ${ctx.unit.attributes.title} for $${ctx.unit.attributes.amountUsd}?`,
    escalate: { afterMinutes: 20, run: pageDeputy },
    timeout: { afterMinutes: 30, decide: ctx => ({ approved: ctx.unit.attributes.amountUsd < 500 }) },
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.signoff.approved)
  .step('execute', executeContract, ctx => ({ contractId: ctx.unit.attributes.contractId }), { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('executed');

const redline = H.signal('redline').payload(z.object({ text: z.string() }));

const Region = z.enum(['eu', 'us']);
const ContractEvent = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  z.object({ type: z.literal('created'), region: Region, contractId: z.string(), title: z.string(), category: CategorySchema, amountUsd: z.number() }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('redline'), region: Region, contractId: z.string(), text: z.string() }),
]);
type ContractEvent = z.infer<typeof ContractEvent>;

const contractEvents = webhook.json('contract-events', {
  port: H.slot.port(3),
  path: '/contracts',
  secret: H.env('CONTRACTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
  payload: ContractEvent,
});

const routeFor = (region: z.infer<typeof Region>) => (event: ContractEvent, to: Router<ContractAttrs>): Route => {
  if (event.region !== region) return to.skip();
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({ contractId: event.contractId, title: event.title, category: event.category, amountUsd: event.amountUsd, redlines: [] });
  }
  return to.signal(redline, event.contractId, { text: event.text });
};

const documents = ironclad.store({ workspace: 'legal', token: H.env('DOCUMENT_SYSTEM_TOKEN') });

const contractsEu = H.lane('contracts-eu', Contract)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(contractEvents, routeFor('eu'))
  .store(documents)
  .handler(contractFlow, { exits: { declined: Declined, rejected: Rejected, executed: Executed } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60000, exhausted: Abandoned })
  .on(redline, { update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, redlines: [...attrs.redlines, payload.text] }), restart: 'draft', at: ['counsel'] });

const contractsUs = H.lane('contracts-us', Contract)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(contractEvents, routeFor('us'))
  .store(documents)
  .handler(contractFlow, { exits: { declined: Declined, rejected: Rejected, executed: Executed } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: Abandoned })
  .on(redline, { update: (attrs, payload) => ({ ...attrs, redlines: [...attrs.redlines, payload.text] }), restart: 'draft', at: ['counsel'] });

export const contractsReport = (metrics: Metrics) => {
  const month = { calendar: 'month' } as const satisfies { calendar: 'month' };
  const signoffs = metrics.decisions({ halt: signoff, window: month });
  const timedOut = signoffs.byResolver.filter(row => row.resolvedBy === 'timeout').reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.count, 0);
  return {
    counselDecisions: metrics.decisions({ halt: counsel, window: month }),
    signoffDecisions: signoffs,
    signoffTimeoutShare: { share: signoffs.samples === 0 ? 0 : timedOut / signoffs.samples, samples: signoffs.samples },
    retriesEu: metrics.attempts({ of: contractsEu, window: month }).retried,
    retriesUs: metrics.attempts({ of: contractsUs, window: month }).retried,
  };
};

export const harness = H.harness('contracts')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .lanes(contractsEu, contractsUs)
  .metrics(counselApproval)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('contracts').standard(contractsEu, contractsUs).wip([contractsEu, contractsUs], 3))
  .clients(
    http.controlApi('counsel-dashboard', { port: H.slot.port(1), token: H.env('COUNSEL_TOKEN'), grants: [H.ops.resolve(counsel)] }),
    claudeCode.supervisor('finance', { port: H.slot.port(2), grants: [H.ops.resolve(signoff)] }),
    http.controlApi('auditor', { port: H.slot.port(4), token: H.env('AUDITOR_TOKEN'), grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.telemetryRead] }),
  )
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }));

=== END ===

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, type Metrics } from 'harness-dsl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { ssh } from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import { folder } from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('ml-api', {
  apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('ml-api', { path: '.harness/quota.db' }),
});
const analyst = H.role('eval-analyst').intents('read').instructions('Summarise an evaluation run for the team.');
const analystSeat = H.seat('eval-analyst')
  .role(analyst)
  .model(anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' }))
  .pool(H.pool('ml').accounts(apiAccount));
const summarizeCall = H.call('summarize-eval', analystSeat);

const localRunner = local.runner('ml-local');
const dbHost = ssh.host('db-admin', { host: 'db-admin.internal', user: 'deploy', key: H.env('DB_ADMIN_SSH_KEY') });
const store = sqlite.store({ path: '.harness/units.db' });

const EvalAttrs = z.object({ runId: z.string(), checkpoint: z.string(), suite: z.string() });
const EvalQueued = H.state('EvalQueued', 'pending');
const EvalScored = H.terminal('EvalScored', 'success');
const EvalFailed = H.terminal('EvalFailed', 'failure');
const EvalRun = H.kind('EvalRun').attributes(EvalAttrs).states(EvalQueued, EvalScored, EvalFailed).key(attrs => attrs.runId).initial(EvalQueued);

const prepareEval = H.command('prepare-eval')
  .input(EvalAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./eval/prepare', input.checkpoint, input.suite])
  .runner(localRunner);
const submitGpuJob = H.command('submit-gpu-job')
  .input(EvalAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./eval/submit', input.checkpoint, input.suite])
  .output(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .runner(localRunner);
const pollGpuJob = H.command('poll-gpu-job')
  .input(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./eval/poll', input.jobId])
  .output(H.jobPoll(z.object({ resultsUri: z.string() })))
  .runner(localRunner);
const gpuEval = H.job('gpu-eval', { submit: submitGpuJob, collect: pollGpuJob, pollEveryMinutes: 10 });
const scoreEval = H.command('score-eval')
  .input(z.object({ resultsUri: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['./eval/score', input.resultsUri])
  .output(z.object({ accuracy: z.number(), report: z.string() }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const evalFlow = H.flow('eval-run')
  .input(EvalAttrs)
  .step('prepare', prepareEval, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .job('gpu', gpuEval, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .step('score', scoreEval, ctx => ({ resultsUri: ctx.steps.gpu.resultsUri }))
  .step('summarize', summarizeCall, ctx => ({
    text: `Summarise ${ctx.unit.attributes.runId}: accuracy ${ctx.steps.score.accuracy}.\n\n${ctx.steps.score.report}`,
  }))
  .exit('scored');

const evals = H.lane('evals', EvalRun)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(store)
  .handler(evalFlow, { exits: { scored: EvalScored } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600000, exhausted: EvalFailed });

const DatabaseName = z.enum(['orders', 'users']);
const databases = { orders: H.resource('orders-db'), users: H.resource('users-db') };

const MigrationAttrs = z.object({ number: z.number(), database: DatabaseName, file: z.string() });
const MigrationQueued = H.state('MigrationQueued', 'pending');
const MigrationHeld = H.state('MigrationHeld', 'waiting');
const MigrationApplied = H.terminal('MigrationApplied', 'success');
const MigrationFailed = H.terminal('MigrationFailed', 'failure');
const Migration = H.kind('Migration')
  .attributes(MigrationAttrs)
  .states(MigrationQueued, MigrationHeld, MigrationApplied, MigrationFailed)
  .key(attrs => String(attrs.number).padStart(4, '0'))
  .initial(MigrationQueued);

const applyMigration = H.command('apply-migration')
  .input(MigrationAttrs)
  .argv(input => ['./db/migrate', input.database, input.file])
  .runner(dbHost);

const migrationFlow = H.flow('apply-migration')
  .input(MigrationAttrs)
  .step('apply', applyMigration, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('applied');

const migrations = H.lane('migrations', Migration)
  .supply(folder.files({ path: 'db/migrations', glob: '*.sql' }), (file, to) => {
    const match = /^(\d{4})-([a-z]+)-/.exec(file.name);
    const database = DatabaseName.safeParse(match?.[2]);
    if (match === null || !database.success) return to.skip();
    return to.create({ number: Number(match[1]), database: database.data, file: file.path });
  })
  .store(store)
  .handler(migrationFlow, { exits: { applied: MigrationApplied } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: MigrationFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'exclusive' }))
  .after({
    key: attrs => (attrs.number > 1 ? String(attrs.number - 1).padStart(4, '0') : undefined),
    onPredecessorFailed: MigrationHeld,
  });

const BackfillAttrs = z.object({ table: z.string(), database: DatabaseName, totalRows: z.number() });
const BackfillQueued = H.state('BackfillQueued', 'pending');
const BackfillDone = H.terminal('BackfillDone', 'success');
const BackfillFailed = H.terminal('BackfillFailed', 'failure');
const Backfill = H.kind('Backfill')
  .attributes(BackfillAttrs)
  .states(BackfillQueued, BackfillDone, BackfillFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.table)
  .initial(BackfillQueued);

const backfillBatch = H.command('backfill-batch')
  .input(z.object({ table: z.string(), database: DatabaseName, offset: z.number(), limit: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['./db/backfill', input.database, input.table, String(input.offset), String(input.limit)])
  .output(z.object({ rows: z.number(), done: z.boolean() }))
  .runner(dbHost);

const backfillFlow = H.flow('backfill')
  .input(BackfillAttrs)
  .loop(
    'batches',
    batch =>
      batch.step(
        'batch',
        backfillBatch,
        ctx => ({ table: ctx.unit.attributes.table, database: ctx.unit.attributes.database, offset: ctx.iteration * 10000, limit: 10000 }),
        { afterCrash: 'rerun' },
      ),
    {
      max: ctx => Math.ceil(ctx.unit.attributes.totalRows / 10000),
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.batch.done,
    },
  )
  .exit('done');

const backfills = H.lane('backfills', Backfill)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .store(store)
  .handler(backfillFlow, { exits: { done: BackfillDone } })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 300000, exhausted: BackfillFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'shared' }));

export const platformReport = (metrics: Metrics) => ({
  gpuInFlightToday: metrics.jobs({ job: gpuEval, window: { calendar: 'day' } }),
  ordersLockWaits: metrics.leases({ resource: databases.orders, window: { lastDays: 1 } }),
  usersLockWaits: metrics.leases({ resource: databases.users, window: { lastDays: 1 } }),
});

export const harness = H.harness('ml-platform')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '.harness/ledger.db' }))
  .lanes(evals, migrations, backfills)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('ml-platform').standard(migrations, backfills, evals).wip(evals, 2))
  .clients(
    claudeCode.supervisor('platform-supervisor', {
      port: H.slot.port(1),
      grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.attemptsRecover, H.ops.telemetryRead],
    }),
  )
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

=== END ===
