import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, BatchModel, Rate } from 'harness-dsl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { pgvector } from 'harness-dsl/pgvector';
import { voyage } from 'harness-dsl/voyage';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const topicAttrs = z.object({ title: z.string(), question: z.string(), recurring: z.boolean() });

const Open = H.state('Open', 'pending');
const Delivered = H.terminal('Delivered', 'success');
const Parked = H.terminal('Parked', 'neutral');
const Cancelled = H.terminal('Cancelled', 'neutral');
const Failed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');

const Topic = H.kind('Topic')
  .attributes(topicAttrs)
  .states(Open, Delivered, Parked, Cancelled, Failed)
  .key(a => a.title)
  .initial(Open);

const apiQuota = sqlite.quota('anthropic-api', { path: 'quota.sqlite' });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('anthropic-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota: apiQuota });
const apiPool = H.pool('api').accounts(apiAccount);

const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const searcherRole = H.role('searcher')
  .intents('search', 'browse')
  .instructions('Search for sources on the angle given and extract claims with their URLs.')
  .output(z.object({ sources: z.array(z.object({ url: z.string(), claim: z.string(), confidence: z.number() })) }));
const synthesizerRole = H.role('synthesizer')
  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Write a sourced report. Every claim cites a URL from the extracted sources.')
  .output(z.object({ report: z.string(), findings: z.array(z.string()) }));

const minimumComparisonSamples = 20;

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizer-model', [opus, sonnet], (ctx): BatchModel => {
  const passRate = (model: BatchModel): Rate =>
    ctx.metrics.rate(citationPassRate, { seat: ctx.seat, model, window: { lastDays: 30 } });
  const opusRecord = passRate(opus);
  const sonnetRecord = passRate(sonnet);
  if (opusRecord.samples < minimumComparisonSamples) return opus;
  if (sonnetRecord.samples < minimumComparisonSamples) return sonnet;
  return opusRecord.rate >= sonnetRecord.rate ? opus : sonnet;
});

const searcher = H.seat('searcher').role(searcherRole).model(haiku).pool(apiPool);
const synthesizer = H.seat('synthesizer').role(synthesizerRole).model(synthesizerModel).pool(apiPool);
const searchAndExtract = H.batch('search-and-extract', searcher);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const citationCheck = H.command('citation-check')
  .input(z.object({ report: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./scripts/check-citations', '--report', i.report])
  .runner(localRunner);

const searchAngles = 20;
const minimumSources = 5;

const research = H.flow('research')
  .input(topicAttrs)
  .job('search', searchAndExtract, ctx =>
    Array.from({ length: searchAngles }, (_, i) => ({
      task: `Search angle ${i + 1} of ${searchAngles} for the question: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}`,
    })),
  )
  .exit('notEnoughSources', ctx => ctx.steps.search.flatMap(r => r.sources).length < minimumSources)
  .step('synthesize', synthesizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Write the report on "${ctx.unit.attributes.title}".\nQuestion: ${ctx.unit.attributes.question}\nSources: ${JSON.stringify(ctx.steps.search.flatMap(r => r.sources))}`,
  }))
  .step('cite', citationCheck, ctx => ({ report: ctx.steps.synthesize.report }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .exit('delivered');

const perTopicCeilingUsd = 3;
const dailyBudgetUsd = 40;

const topics = H.lane('topics', Topic)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(
    sqlite.scan('recurring-topics', {
      path: 'research.sqlite',
      kind: Topic,
      states: [Delivered, Parked],
      schedule: H.clock('weekly-reopen').at('06:00', { on: 'mon', tz: 'Europe/London' }),
    }),
    (found, to) => (found.attributes.recurring ? to.create(found.attributes) : to.skip()),
  )
  .handler(research, { exits: { notEnoughSources: Parked, delivered: Delivered } })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: 'research.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: Failed })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: Cancelled })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: perTopicCeilingUsd, onExceed: 'fail' });

const citationPassRate = H.metric('citation-pass-rate', H.when.step(topics, 'cite')).samples(e => [
  { hit: e.ok, seat: e.seats.synthesize?.seat, model: e.seats.synthesize?.model },
]);

const researchSpend = H.metric('research-spend', H.when.invocation({ lanes: [topics] })).amounts(e => [
  { amount: e.costUsd, seat: e.seat, model: e.model },
]);

const deliveredAttemptCost = H.metric('delivered-attempt-cost', H.when.transition(topics, { to: Delivered })).amounts(e =>
  e.attempt === undefined ? [] : [{ amount: e.attempt.costUsd }],
);

const findings = H.journal('prior-findings', H.memory('report-finding', 'experience'))
  .store(
    pgvector.memoryStore({
      url: H.env('FINDINGS_DATABASE_URL'),
      table: 'findings',
      embedder: voyage.embedder('voyage', { id: 'voyage-3', apiKey: H.env('VOYAGE_API_KEY') }),
    }),
  )
  .recall({ by: 'similarity', limit: 6 })
  .readBy(synthesizerRole);

const sourceExperience = H.journal('source-experience', H.memory('source-experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/sources.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(searcherRole, synthesizerRole)
  .recordedBy(synthesizerRole);

const deliveredReportsBecomeFindings = H.trigger('delivered-reports-become-findings')
  .on(H.when.step(topics, 'cite', { if: e => e.ok }))
  .record(findings, e => {
    const report = e.outputs.synthesize;
    return report === undefined
      ? undefined
      : {
          text: `When researching a question like "${e.unit.attributes.question}", start from: ${report.findings.join('; ')}, because a delivered report established them with checked citations.`,
          when: { kinds: [Topic] },
        };
  });

const scheduler = H.scheduler('research')
  .standard(topics)
  .admit(topics, ctx => {
    const spentToday = ctx.metrics.total(researchSpend, { window: { calendar: 'day', tz: 'Europe/London' } });
    const delivered = ctx.metrics.total(deliveredAttemptCost, { window: { lastDays: 30 } });
    const projectedUsd = delivered.samples === 0 ? perTopicCeilingUsd : delivered.total / delivered.samples;
    return spentToday.total + projectedUsd <= dailyBudgetUsd;
  });

const operator = claudeCode.supervisor('operator', {
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.workCancel, H.ops.memoryRead, H.ops.memoryWrite, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('research-pipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'harness.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(topics)
  .journals(findings, sourceExperience)
  .triggers(deliveredReportsBecomeFindings)
  .metrics(citationPassRate, researchSpend, deliveredAttemptCost)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(operator)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, AgentTask } from 'harness-dsl';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';
import { contentful } from 'harness-dsl/contentful';

const sectionEnum = z.enum(['news', 'sports', 'opinion', 'culture']);
const sections = H.resources('section', sectionEnum.options);

const draftAttrs = z.object({ entryId: z.string(), title: z.string(), section: z.string(), body: z.string() });
type DraftAttrs = z.infer<typeof draftAttrs>;

const Submitted = H.state('Submitted', 'pending');
const Stalled = H.state('Stalled', 'waiting');
const Accepted = H.terminal('Accepted', 'success');
const Returned = H.terminal('Returned', 'failure');

const Draft = H.kind('Draft')
  .attributes(draftAttrs)
  .states(Submitted, Stalled, Accepted, Returned)
  .key(a => a.entryId)
  .initial(Submitted);

const editorial = H.halt('editorial-decision').decision(
  z.object({
    verdict: z.enum(['accept', 'return']),
    notes: z.string(),
    actedOnFirst: z.boolean(),
    actedOnSecond: z.boolean(),
    tasteScope: z.enum(['all', 'section']),
  }),
);

const subscriptionQuota = sqlite.quota('claude-subscriptions', { path: 'quota.sqlite' });
const editorialPlan = claudeCode.subscription('editorial-plan', { token: H.env('CLAUDE_EDITORIAL_TOKEN'), quota: subscriptionQuota });
const editorialPool = H.pool('editorial').accounts(editorialPlan);

const opus = claudeCode.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = claudeCode.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });
const haiku = claudeCode.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const reviewerCandidates = [opus, sonnet, haiku];

const reviewerRole = H.role('reviewer')
  .intents('read')
  .instructions('Critique the draft against house taste. Return concrete, actionable points.')
  .output(z.object({ points: z.array(z.string()) }));

const swapAfterSamples = 50;

const reviewerModels = H.policy.model('reviewer-models', reviewerCandidates, ctx => {
  const held = ctx.rivals.map(r => r.model);
  const free = reviewerCandidates.filter(m => held.includes(m) === false);
  const current = ctx.current ?? free[0] ?? opus;
  const rival = ctx.rivals[0];
  if (rival === undefined) return current;
  const window = { lastDays: 90 };
  const mine = ctx.metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { seat: ctx.seat, model: current, window });
  const theirs = ctx.metrics.rate(critiqueActedOn, { seat: rival.seat, model: rival.model, window });
  if (mine.samples < swapAfterSamples || theirs.samples < swapAfterSamples || mine.rate >= theirs.rate) return current;
  return free.find(m => m !== current) ?? current;
});

const firstReviewer = H.seat('first-reviewer').role(reviewerRole).model(reviewerModels).pool(editorialPool);
const secondReviewer = H.seat('second-reviewer').role(reviewerRole).model(reviewerModels).pool(editorialPool);

const localRunner = local.runner('local');
const factCheck = H.command('fact-check')
  .input(z.object({ title: z.string(), body: z.string() }))
  .argv(i => ['./editorial/fact-check', '--title', i.title, '--body', i.body])
  .output(z.object({ issues: z.array(z.string()), repeatLesson: z.string().optional() }))
  .runner(localRunner);
const mergeCritiques = H.command('merge-critiques')
  .input(z.object({ first: z.array(z.string()), second: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(i => ['./editorial/merge-critiques', JSON.stringify(i)])
  .output(z.object({ merged: z.string() }))
  .runner(localRunner);

const sectionOf = (section: string) => {
  const member = sections.parse(section);
  return member === undefined ? [] : [member];
};

const reviewTask = (draft: DraftAttrs, issues: readonly string[]): AgentTask => ({
  task: [`Critique the draft "${draft.title}".`, draft.body, ...issues.map(i => `Fact-check issue: ${i}`)].join('\n\n'),
  resources: sectionOf(draft.section),
});

const review = H.flow('review-draft')
  .input(draftAttrs)
  .step('factCheck', factCheck, ctx => ({ title: ctx.unit.attributes.title, body: ctx.unit.attributes.body }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('firstCritique', firstReviewer, ctx => reviewTask(ctx.unit.attributes, ctx.steps.factCheck.issues))
  .step('secondCritique', secondReviewer, ctx => reviewTask(ctx.unit.attributes, ctx.steps.factCheck.issues))
  .step('merge', mergeCritiques, ctx => ({ first: ctx.steps.firstCritique.points, second: ctx.steps.secondCritique.points }))
  .halt('editorial', editorial, {
    ask: ctx => ctx.steps.merge.merged,
    resources: ctx => sectionOf(ctx.unit.attributes.section),
  })
  .exit('accepted', ctx => ctx.steps.editorial.verdict === 'accept')
  .exit('returned');

const cmsToken = H.env('CONTENTFUL_TOKEN');

const drafts = H.lane('drafts', Draft)
  .supply(contentful.drafts({ space: 'publication', token: cmsToken, everyMinutes: 15 }), (entry, to) =>
    to.create({ entryId: entry.id, title: entry.title, section: entry.section, body: entry.body }),
  )
  .handler(review, { exits: { accepted: Accepted, returned: Returned } })
  .store(contentful.store({ space: 'publication', token: cmsToken }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 120_000, exhausted: Stalled });

const critiqueActedOn = H.metric('critique-acted-on', H.when.decision(Draft, editorial)).samples(e =>
  e.seats
    .filter(a => a.seat === firstReviewer || a.seat === secondReviewer)
    .map(a => ({
      hit: a.seat === firstReviewer ? e.decision.actedOnFirst : e.decision.actedOnSecond,
      seat: a.seat,
      model: a.model,
      resources: e.resources,
    })),
);

const taste = H.journal('editor-taste', H.memory('taste', 'taste'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 15 })
  .readBy(reviewerRole);

const factCheckingExperience = H.journal('fact-checking-experience', H.memory('experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: 'memory/fact-checking.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(reviewerRole);

const returnedNotesBecomeTasteCandidates = H.trigger('returned-notes-become-taste-candidates')
  .on(H.when.decision(Draft, editorial))
  .record(taste, e =>
    e.decision.verdict === 'return'
      ? {
          text: e.decision.notes,
          status: 'candidate',
          when: e.decision.tasteScope === 'section' ? { roles: [reviewerRole], resources: e.resources } : { roles: [reviewerRole] },
        }
      : undefined,
  );

const repeatMistakesBecomeExperience = H.trigger('repeat-mistakes-become-experience')
  .on(H.when.step(drafts, 'factCheck', { if: e => e.output?.repeatLesson !== undefined }))
  .record(factCheckingExperience, e => {
    const lesson = e.output?.repeatLesson;
    return lesson === undefined ? undefined : { text: lesson, when: { roles: [reviewerRole] } };
  });

const editor = claudeCode.supervisor('editor', {
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.resolve(editorial),
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.memoryCurate,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('content-review')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: 'harness.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(drafts)
  .journals(taste, factCheckingExperience)
  .triggers(returnedNotesBecomeTasteCandidates, repeatMistakesBecomeExperience)
  .metrics(critiqueActedOn)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('editorial').standard(drafts).wip(drafts, 3))
  .clients(editor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: 'BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: 'TELEMETRY.md' }));

  .on(negotiationExpired, { enter: Expired });

export const harness = H.harness('lifecycles')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '/srv/lifecycles/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(experiments, tenancies, negotiations)
  .triggers(negotiationExpiry)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(operations)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '/srv/lifecycles/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '/srv/lifecycles/TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();

  .runner(buildHost);

const announce = H.command('announce')
  .input(version)
  .argv(release => ['./release/announce.sh', release.version])
  .runner(buildHost);

const announcementPosted = H.command('announcement-posted')
  .input(version)
  .argv(release => ['./release/announcement-posted.sh', release.version])
  .output(z.boolean())
  .runner(buildHost);

const releaseApproval = H.halt('release-approval').decision(z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), note: z.string() }));

const SmokeQueued = H.state('SmokeQueued', 'pending');
const SmokePassed = H.terminal('SmokePassed', 'success');
const SmokeFailed = H.terminal('SmokeFailed', 'failure');
const smokeAttrs = z.object({ version: z.string(), platform: z.string() });
const Smoke = H.kind('Smoke').attributes(smokeAttrs).states(SmokeQueued, SmokePassed, SmokeFailed).initial(SmokeQueued);

const smokeTest = H.command('smoke-test')
  .input(smokeAttrs)
  .argv(target => ['./release/smoke.sh', target.version, target.platform])
  .runner(buildHost);

const smokeFlow = H.flow('smoke')
  .input(smokeAttrs)
  .step('run', smokeTest, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .exit('passed');

const smoke = H.lane('smoke', Smoke)
  .handler(smokeFlow, { exits: { passed: SmokePassed } })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: '/srv/release/units.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, exhausted: SmokeFailed });

const Requested = H.state('Requested', 'pending');
const Released = H.terminal('Released', 'success');
const SmokeRed = H.terminal('SmokeRed', 'failure');
const Rejected = H.terminal('Rejected', 'neutral');
const ReleaseFailed = H.terminal('ReleaseFailed', 'failure');
const releaseAttrs = z.object({ version: z.string(), platforms: z.array(z.string()) });
const Release = H.kind('Release')
  .attributes(releaseAttrs)
  .states(Requested, Released, SmokeRed, Rejected, ReleaseFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.version)
  .initial(Requested);

const ship = H.flow('ship')
  .input(releaseAttrs)
  .step('build', build, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('announce', announce, ctx => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version }), { afterCrash: 'park', alreadyDone: announcementPosted })
  .step('review', reviewer, ctx => ({ task: `Review release ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}` }), { afterCrash: 'askDriver' })
  .halt('approval', releaseApproval, {
    ask: ctx => `Ship ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}? Reviewer: ${ctx.steps.review.verdict}; risks: ${ctx.steps.review.risks.join(', ')}`,
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.approval.approved)
  .job('summarize', releaseNotes, ctx => [{ task: `Write release notes for ${ctx.unit.attributes.version}` }])
  .spawn('smoke', smoke, ctx =>
    ctx.unit.attributes.platforms.map(platform => ({ version: ctx.unit.attributes.version, platform })),
  )
  .exit('smokeFailed', ctx => ctx.steps.smoke.some(child => child.verdict !== 'success'))
  .exit('released');

const releases = H.lane('releases', Release)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(ship, { exits: { rejected: Rejected, smokeFailed: SmokeRed, released: Released } })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: '/srv/release/units.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: ReleaseFailed });

const releaseManager = claudeCode.supervisor('release-manager', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.resolve(releaseApproval), H.ops.attemptsRecover, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('release')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '/srv/release/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(releases, smoke)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('release').standard(releases, smoke))
  .clients(releaseManager)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '/srv/release/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '/srv/release/TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H, Route, Router, Retry } from 'harness-dsl';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { http } from 'harness-dsl/http';
import { webhook } from 'harness-dsl/webhook';
import { ironclad } from 'harness-dsl/ironclad';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const contractCategory = z.enum(['nda', 'msa', 'sow', 'vendor']);
const category = H.resources('contract-category', contractCategory.options);

const legalHost = local.runner('legal-host');

const subscription = claudeCode.subscription('contracts-subscription', {
  token: H.env('CLAUDE_TOKEN'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('contracts-quota', { path: '/srv/contracts/quota.sqlite' }),
});
const sonnet = claudeCode.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const drafter = H.seat('contract-drafter')
  .role(
    H.role('contract-drafter')
      .intents('read', 'search')
      .instructions('Draft the contract, applying every redline and every counsel note.')
      .output(z.object({ document: z.string() })),
  )
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(H.pool('contracts').accounts(subscription));

const contractAttrs = z.object({
  contractId: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  category: contractCategory,
  amountUsd: z.number(),
  redlines: z.array(z.string()),
});

const Received = H.state('Received', 'pending');
const Executed = H.terminal('Executed', 'success');
const Rejected = H.terminal('Rejected', 'failure');
const Declined = H.terminal('Declined', 'failure');
const DraftingFailed = H.terminal('DraftingFailed', 'failure');
const Contract = H.kind('Contract')
  .attributes(contractAttrs)
  .states(Received, Executed, Rejected, Declined, DraftingFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.contractId)
  .initial(Received);

const counselReview = H.halt('counsel').decision(z.object({ verdict: z.enum(['approve', 'return']), notes: z.string() }));
const financeSignoff = H.halt('signoff').decision(z.object({ approved: z.boolean() }));

const counselApprovals = H.metric('counsel-approvals', H.when.decision(Contract, counselReview)).samples(event =>
  event.resolvedBy === 'human'
    ? [{ hit: event.decision.verdict === 'approve', halt: event.halt, resources: event.resources }]
    : [],
);

const signoffByTimeout = H.metric('signoff-resolved-by-timeout', H.when.decision(Contract, financeSignoff)).samples(event => [
  { hit: event.resolvedBy === 'timeout', halt: event.halt, resources: event.resources },
]);

const skipCounsel = H.policy.halt('skip-counsel-for-proven-categories', Contract, counselReview).decide(ctx => {
  const record = ctx.metrics.rate(counselApprovals, { halt: counselReview, resources: ctx.resources });
  return record.samples >= 200 && record.hits === record.samples
    ? { verdict: 'approve', notes: `skipped: ${record.samples} approved samples, none returned` }
    : undefined;
});

const pageFinanceDeputy = H.command('page-finance-deputy').argv(['./contracts/page-deputy.sh']).runner(legalHost);

const executeContract = H.command('execute-contract')
  .input(z.object({ contractId: z.string() }))
  .argv(contract => ['./contracts/execute.sh', contract.contractId])
  .runner(legalHost);

const contractFlow = H.flow('contract')
  .input(contractAttrs)
  .loop(
    'rounds',
    z.object({ notes: z.array(z.string()) }),
    body =>
      body
        .step('draft', drafter, ctx => ({
          task: [
            `Draft ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}.`,
            ...ctx.unit.attributes.redlines.map(redline => `Apply redline: ${redline}`),
            ...(ctx.steps.rounds?.notes ?? []).map(note => `Address counsel note: ${note}`),
          ].join('\n'),
          resources: [category.of(ctx.unit.attributes.category)],
        }))
        .halt('counsel', counselReview, {
          ask: ctx => `Review the draft of ${ctx.unit.attributes.title}.`,
          skip: skipCounsel,
          resources: ctx => [category.of(ctx.unit.attributes.category)],
          bound: { counts: decision => decision.verdict === 'return', maxCount: 2, exit: 'declined' },
        }),
    {
      max: 8,
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.counsel.verdict === 'approve',
      carry: ctx => ({ notes: [...(ctx.steps.rounds?.notes ?? []), ctx.steps.counsel.notes] }),
    },
  )
  .halt('signoff', financeSignoff, {
    ask: ctx => `Sign off ${ctx.unit.attributes.title} for $${ctx.unit.attributes.amountUsd}?`,
    resources: ctx => [category.of(ctx.unit.attributes.category)],
    escalate: { afterMinutes: 20, run: pageFinanceDeputy },
    timeout: { afterMinutes: 30, decide: ctx => ({ approved: ctx.unit.attributes.amountUsd < 500 }) },
  })
  .exit('rejected', ctx => !ctx.steps.signoff.approved)
  .step('execute', executeContract, ctx => ({ contractId: ctx.unit.attributes.contractId }), { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('executed');

const contractEvent = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('created'),
    contractId: z.string(),
    title: z.string(),
    category: contractCategory,
    amountUsd: z.number(),
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('redline'), contractId: z.string(), text: z.string() }),
]);

const redline = H.signal('redline').payload(z.object({ text: z.string() }));

const routeContract = (event: z.infer<typeof contractEvent>, to: Router<z.infer<typeof contractAttrs>>): Route =>
  event.type === 'created'
    ? to.create({
        contractId: event.contractId,
        title: event.title,
        category: event.category,
        amountUsd: event.amountUsd,
        redlines: [],
      })
    : to.signal(redline, event.contractId, { text: event.text });

const documentSystem = ironclad.store({ workspace: 'legal', token: H.env('IRONCLAD_TOKEN') });

const contractLane = (name: string, slot: number, retry: Retry) =>
  H.lane(name, Contract)
    .supply(H.operator)
    .supply(
      webhook.json(`${name}-events`, {
        port: H.slot.port(slot),
        path: `/${name}`,
        secret: H.env('CONTRACTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET'),
        payload: contractEvent,
      }),
      routeContract,
    )
    .handler(contractFlow, { exits: { declined: Declined, rejected: Rejected, executed: Executed } })
    .store(documentSystem)
    .retry({ ...retry, exhausted: DraftingFailed })
    .on(redline, {
      update: (attrs, change) => ({ ...attrs, redlines: [...attrs.redlines, change.text] }),
      rewind: 'draft',
      at: ['draft', 'counsel'],
    });

const contractsEu = contractLane('contracts-eu', 1, { maxAttempts: 4, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60_000 });
const contractsUs = contractLane('contracts-us', 2, { maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 60_000 });

const counselDashboard = http.controlApi('counsel-dashboard', {
  port: H.slot.port(3),
  token: H.env('COUNSEL_TOKEN'),
  grants: [H.ops.resolve(counselReview)],
});

const finance = claudeCode.supervisor('finance', {
  port: H.slot.port(4),
  grants: [H.ops.resolve(financeSignoff)],
});

const auditor = http.controlApi('auditor', {
  port: H.slot.port(5),
  token: H.env('AUDITOR_TOKEN'),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

const operatorDesk = http.controlApi('operator-desk', {
  port: H.slot.port(6),
  token: H.env('OPERATOR_TOKEN'),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate],
});

export const harness = H.harness('contracts')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '/srv/contracts/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(contractsEu, contractsUs)
  .metrics(counselApprovals, signoffByTimeout)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('contracts').standard(contractsEu, contractsUs).wip([contractsEu, contractsUs], 3))
  .clients(counselDashboard, finance, auditor, operatorDesk)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '/srv/contracts/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '/srv/contracts/TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { folder } from 'harness-dsl/folder';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { ssh } from 'harness-dsl/ssh';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const harnessStore = sqlite.store({ path: '/srv/ml/units.sqlite' });
const workstation = local.runner('ml-workstation').slots(4);
const databaseHost = ssh.host('database-admin', { host: 'db-admin.internal', user: 'deploy', key: H.env('DB_ADMIN_SSH_KEY') }).slots(4);

const apiAccount = anthropic.account('ml-api', {
  apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'),
  quota: sqlite.quota('ml-api', { path: '/srv/ml/quota.sqlite' }),
});
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const summarizer = H.seat('eval-summarizer')
  .role(H.role('eval-summarizer').intents('read').instructions('Summarise the evaluation result for the model team.'))
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(H.pool('ml').accounts(apiAccount));

const databaseName = z.enum(['orders', 'billing', 'analytics']);
const database = H.resources('database', databaseName.options);

const evalAttrs = z.object({ suite: z.string(), checkpoint: z.string() });
const evalResult = z.object({ accuracy: z.number(), examples: z.number() });

const EvalQueued = H.state('EvalQueued', 'pending');
const Scored = H.terminal('Scored', 'success');
const EvalFailed = H.terminal('EvalFailed', 'failure');
const EvalRun = H.kind('EvalRun').attributes(evalAttrs).states(EvalQueued, Scored, EvalFailed).initial(EvalQueued);

const prepareEval = H.command('prepare-eval')
  .input(evalAttrs)
  .argv(run => ['./eval/prepare.sh', run.suite, run.checkpoint])
  .runner(workstation);

const submitEval = H.command('submit-gpu-eval')
  .input(evalAttrs)
  .argv(run => ['./eval/submit.sh', run.suite, run.checkpoint])
  .output(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .runner(workstation);

const collectEval = H.command('collect-gpu-eval')
  .input(z.object({ jobId: z.string() }))
  .argv(handle => ['./eval/status.sh', handle.jobId])
  .output(H.jobPoll(evalResult))
  .runner(workstation);

const gpuEval = H.job('gpu-eval', { submit: submitEval, collect: collectEval, pollEveryMinutes: 10 });

const scoreEval = H.command('score-eval')
  .input(evalResult)
  .argv(result => ['./eval/score.sh', String(result.accuracy), String(result.examples)])
  .output(z.object({ score: z.number() }))
  .runner(workstation);

const evaluate = H.flow('evaluate')
  .input(evalAttrs)
  .step('prepare', prepareEval, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .job('gpu', gpuEval, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes)
  .step('score', scoreEval, ctx => ctx.steps.gpu, { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('summarize', summarizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Summarise ${ctx.unit.attributes.suite} on ${ctx.unit.attributes.checkpoint}: accuracy ${ctx.steps.gpu.accuracy}, score ${ctx.steps.score.score}.`,
  }))
  .exit('scored');

const evals = H.lane('evals', EvalRun)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(evaluate, { exits: { scored: Scored } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 900_000, exhausted: EvalFailed });

const migrationAttrs = z.object({ number: z.string(), database: databaseName, file: z.string() });

const MigrationQueued = H.state('MigrationQueued', 'pending');
const HeldForPredecessor = H.state('HeldForPredecessor', 'waiting');
const Applied = H.terminal('Applied', 'success');
const MigrationFailed = H.terminal('MigrationFailed', 'failure');
const Migration = H.kind('Migration')
  .attributes(migrationAttrs)
  .states(MigrationQueued, HeldForPredecessor, Applied, MigrationFailed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.number)
  .initial(MigrationQueued);

const applyMigration = H.command('apply-migration')
  .input(migrationAttrs)
  .argv(migration => ['./db/migrate.sh', migration.database, migration.file])
  .runner(databaseHost);

const migrate = H.flow('migrate')
  .input(migrationAttrs)
  .step('apply', applyMigration, ctx => ctx.unit.attributes, { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('applied');

const migrations = H.lane('migrations', Migration)
  .supply(folder.files({ path: 'migrations', glob: '*.sql' }), (file, to) => {
    const parts = file.name.split('-');
    const number = parts[0] ?? '';
    const target = database.parse(parts[1] ?? '');
    return target === undefined || number === '' ? to.skip() : to.create({ number, database: target.value, file: file.path });
  })
  .handler(migrate, { exits: { applied: Applied } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: MigrationFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: database.of(unit.attributes.database), mode: 'exclusive' }))
  .after({
    key: attrs => (Number(attrs.number) <= 1 ? undefined : String(Number(attrs.number) - 1).padStart(4, '0')),
    onPredecessorFailed: HeldForPredecessor,
  });

const backfillAttrs = z.object({ database: databaseName, table: z.string(), rows: z.number() });

const BackfillQueued = H.state('BackfillQueued', 'pending');
const Filled = H.terminal('Filled', 'success');
const BackfillFailed = H.terminal('BackfillFailed', 'failure');
const Backfill = H.kind('Backfill')
  .attributes(backfillAttrs)
  .states(BackfillQueued, Filled, BackfillFailed)
  .key(attrs => `${attrs.database}.${attrs.table}`)
  .initial(BackfillQueued);

const rowsPerBatch = 10_000;

const copyBatch = H.command('copy-batch')
  .input(z.object({ database: z.string(), table: z.string(), offset: z.number(), limit: z.number() }))
  .argv(batch => ['./db/backfill.sh', batch.database, batch.table, String(batch.offset), String(batch.limit)])
  .runner(databaseHost);

const backfill = H.flow('backfill')
  .input(backfillAttrs)
  .loop(
    'batches',
    body =>
      body.step(
        'copy',
        copyBatch,
        ctx => ({
          database: ctx.unit.attributes.database,
          table: ctx.unit.attributes.table,
          offset: ctx.iteration * rowsPerBatch,
          limit: rowsPerBatch,
        }),
        { afterCrash: 'rerun', retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 30_000 } },
      ),
    { max: ctx => Math.ceil(ctx.unit.attributes.rows / rowsPerBatch) },
  )
  .exit('filled');

const backfills = H.lane('backfills', Backfill)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(backfill, { exits: { filled: Filled } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'fixed', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: BackfillFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: database.of(unit.attributes.database), mode: 'shared' }));

const platformSupervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('platform-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  grants: [H.ops.workRead, H.ops.workCreate, H.ops.attemptsRecover, H.ops.telemetryRead],
});

export const harness = H.harness('ml-platform')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: '/srv/ml/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(evals, migrations, backfills)
  .scheduler(H.scheduler('ml-platform').standard(migrations, backfills, evals).wip(evals, 2))
  .clients(platformSupervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: '/srv/ml/BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: '/srv/ml/TELEMETRY.md' }));

void harness.start();
